# Tridan Contracting

> Licensed, insured general contractor based in Milton, Ontario, serving the Greater Toronto Area and Golden Horseshoe. One contractor for outdoor living, home renovations, and interior and exterior painting.

Contact: 416-700-4230 | tridancontractor@gmail.com
Service area: Milton (home base), plus the GTA, Halton, Peel, Durham, Hamilton, Niagara and the wider Golden Horseshoe.

## Services
- Outdoor Living: decks, interlocking and patios, pergolas and gazebos, outdoor kitchens, fences and gates, retaining walls
- Renovations: kitchens, bathrooms, basement finishing, home additions, flooring
- Painting: interior painting, exterior painting, cabinet refinishing
- Landscaping: full landscape design and build

## Trust
Licensed and insured, WSIB covered, $5M liability, written 5-year workmanship warranty, free on-site estimates, financing available (OAC). Permits handled.
